title: New Xbox CEO Asha Sharma killed 'This Is An Xbox' campaign upon taking over — report
content: Xbox's new CEO Asha Sharma was the driving force behind Microsoft's decision to kill the 'This is an Xbox' marketing campaign shortly after taking the helm, according to The Information. All evidence of the campaign, except a few YouTube videos, was scrubbed from the internet following Sharma's appointment. The move signals a strategic reset in Xbox's brand communications under new leadership.
